name: Jawad Ali
title: AI Engineer
bio: I'm a results-driven AI/ML Engineer and BS Artificial Intelligence graduate from COMSATS University Islamabad with hands-on experience building production-ready Generative AI systems, LLM applications, and end-to-end automation pipelines. I specialize in designing agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph, building RAG pipelines with vector databases, and deploying LLM-powered chatbots via FastAPI and Streamlit. I'm committed to delivering scalable, clean AI architectures that drive measurable business value.

highlights: Designed and deployed autonomous LangChain ReAct agents and LangGraph-based multi-agent systems, automating complex multi-step business workflows across cloud infrastructure.
Built end-to-end AI automation workflows using n8n for intelligent scheduling, data ingestion, webhook handling, routing, and third-party API orchestration.
Implemented and deployed RAG pipelines integrating FAISS and Pinecone vector databases for scalable semantic search and document-based question answering.
Developed production-grade deep learning and classical ML pipelines; integrated trained models into live systems via FastAPI REST APIs.
Connected and fine-tuned LLMs (OpenAI GPT-4, Claude API, HuggingFace Transformers) to CRMs, databases, and operational services.
Enforced MLOps best practices including MLflow experiment tracking, Docker containerization, and CI/CD pipelines on AWS and Azure.
Engineered prompt engineering strategies and tool/function-calling architectures to improve LLM reasoning and reduce hallucinations.

projects.name: Business Analyser Agent
projects.description: Autonomous Generative AI system for dynamic business data analysis.
highlights: Built a multi-step autonomous agent using LangChain ReAct with tool-calling, memory management, and intelligent decision routing — deployed on AWS.
Integrated n8n for automated scheduling, data ingestion pipelines, and cross-service orchestration.
Delivered FastAPI REST backend connecting the agent to PostgreSQL; containerized with Docker and tracked with MLflow.

projects.name: HEZOP Analyzer Agent
projects.description: AI-powered HEZOP analysis agent integrated with AutoCAD for process safety engineering.
highlights: Built an agent integrated with AutoCAD to analyze P&ID diagrams, identify process hazards, and assist HEZOP engineers.
Implemented a RAG-based knowledge pipeline over engineering safety documents for domain-specific safety queries.

projects.name: Car Price Analyst Agent
projects.description: Intelligent agent that scrapes car listings, applies filters, and predicts fair market prices.
highlights: Scrapes second-hand car listings from Belgium-based platforms and predicts fair market prices using ML models.
Automated end-to-end pipeline from data scraping and price evaluation to autonomous email delivery.

projects.name: Vehicle Insurance Prediction — MLOps Pipeline
projects.description: End-to-end ML pipeline for vehicle insurance claim prediction with full MLOps lifecycle.
highlights: Built complete ML pipeline covering preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation.
Implemented MLflow Model Registry, Docker containerization, and AWS S3 for artifact storage.

projects.name: SmartInfo — YouTube & Document Content Analyzer
projects.description: Final Year Project: RAG-powered content analyzer for YouTube transcripts and documents.
highlights: Designed end-to-end RAG pipeline with FAISS vector search and LangChain agent tools for intelligent Q&A.
Fine-tuned HuggingFace transformer models; integrated React.js frontend with FastAPI backend.
Improved answer relevance and reduced hallucination through hybrid retrieval and advanced prompt engineering.

faqs.question: Are you open to remote work?
faqs.answer: Yes, I'm open to remote work. I'm currently working remotely with OptimAIze BE in Belgium, and I'm comfortable collaborating across time zones.

faqs.question: What's your strongest area?
faqs.answer: My strongest area is building production-ready Generative AI systems — especially agentic workflows with LangChain/LangGraph, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (OpenAI, Claude), and MLOps deployment with Docker, MLflow, and cloud platforms.
